blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY — House Deputy House Speaker and Bacolod City Rep. Alfredo Benitez on Thursday strongly condemned the discriminatory and insulting remarks directed at Josh Aquino in a viral podcast. He warned that freedom of expression is not a license to demean persons with special needs. In a statement posted on his official Facebook page, Benitez emphasized that derogatory jokes directed at individuals on the autism spectrum perpetuate ableism and undermine human dignity.
